narrative: In the account book. The narrow book is open. He writes one line for the week. He does not rule a new total under Monday's line. The forty-five are the share, sitting as a share. In the account book. No subtraction from twenty-three pound ten. No June figure. No second sum beside Thursday's box. The pen stops.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Entered the line without a jest, and did not count the box again.

entities.name: 45s
entities.context: Shown on ledger in Item, my share
